summary: Practise structured hiring, HR process audits, and bias monitoring. Explore the five-day course and its applied exercises.
lede: Corporate unconscious bias training for HR professionals examines how automatic associations can shape workplace decisions and how to review people processes. Designed for HR business partners, recruiters and people analytics specialists, it develops practical skills in mapping decision points, structuring interviews, calibrating ratings and reviewing selection patterns, with attention to the IAT’s limitations and follow-up monitoring.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for HR professionals who review or influence hiring, performance, promotion, and workforce inclusion processes.
modules: NIST AI RMF for Hiring Systems
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working experience in an HR, recruitment, people analytics, or workforce inclusion role is expected. Familiarity with recruitment or performance processes is useful. No coding or programming is required; spreadsheet exercises use Excel.
